name: bob-reset-carol
description: As u/bob (creator admin), open the admin panel, load u/carol, capture her BEFORE state, then Reset User + CONFIRM RESET and hard-assert she comes back wiped. Idempotent: if carol already has no user record it reports 'nothing to reset' and still verifies the clean state. Use this to get a clean slate before re-testing level/ability progression across multiple games.

steps._comment: bob is a hardcoded CREATOR_ADMIN (server/core/admin.ts). Also restarts the dev server, so server-side changes are picked up.
HARD ASSERT: DBG toggle is admin-only. Times out if the acting user is not an admin.

steps.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=debug-input]'); if (!el) return 'ERR: no debug input'; if (el.value !== 'admin') { const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(el, 'admin'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } el.focus(); el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', keyCode: 13, which: 13, bubbles: true })); return 'submitted'; })()
steps.name: run 'admin' command

steps._comment: HARD ASSERT: User tab exists. click fails the run if the selector is missing.
HARD ASSERT: carol appears in the username browser. Fails if she has never been seen by the app at all.

steps.expression: (() => { const stats = {}; document.querySelectorAll('table tr').forEach(tr => { const td = tr.querySelectorAll('td'); if (td.length === 2) stats[td[0].innerText.trim()] = td[1].innerText.trim(); }); const abilityRows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('td[colspan="8"]')).map(td => td.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean); const hasRecord = !!Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Reset User'); return JSON.stringify({ hasRecord, stats, abilityRows }, null, 1); })()
steps.name: BEFORE: carol stats + roster abilities

steps._comment: Only attempt the reset when carol actually has a user record. Re-running after a successful reset takes the else-path instead of failing.
First click arms the two-step confirm.
HARD ASSERT: the confirm step armed.
HARD ASSERT: the server confirmed the reset. This is the assertion that actually fails the run if resetUser errored.
HARD ASSERT: the user stats table is gone, i.e. getUser now returns no record.

steps.expression: (() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const i = t.indexOf('has been reset'); return i < 0 ? 'no reset performed this run (carol had no user record)' : t.slice(Math.max(0, i - 40), i + 40).trim(); })()
steps.name: reset outcome

steps._comment: Reload carol from the server to confirm the wipe survived a round-trip, not just a local state clear.
HARD ASSERT: after re-fetching from the server, carol still has no user record.

steps.expression: (() => { const panelOpen = /ADMIN PANEL/.test(document.body.innerText); const stats = {}; document.querySelectorAll('table tr').forEach(tr => { const td = tr.querySelectorAll('td'); if (td.length === 2) stats[td[0].innerText.trim()] = td[1].innerText.trim(); }); const abilityRows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('td[colspan="8"]')).map(td => td.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean); const hasRecord = !!Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Reset User'); const problems = []; if (!panelOpen) problems.push('admin panel is not open - result is meaningless'); if (hasRecord) problems.push('user record survived the reset'); if (abilityRows.length) problems.push('roster still has ' + abilityRows.length + ' ability rows'); return JSON.stringify({ verdict: problems.length ? 'FAIL: ' + problems.join('; ') : 'PASS: carol is wiped - clean slate for progression testing', panelOpen, hasRecord, stats, abilityRows }, null, 1); })()
steps.name: AFTER: verify carol is wiped
